# NestedAreaChart

**Class:** `UltraCanvasNestedAreaChart` · **Group:** [Charts](../Groups/Charts.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasNestedAreaChart.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasNestedAreaChart.h) · `#include "Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasNestedAreaChart.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasChartElementBase`](UltraCanvasChartElementBase.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

Parts of a whole, nested: sunburst, treemap, layered proportional areas

## Guides and examples

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

- [UltraCanvasNestedAreaChartExamples](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasNestedAreaChartExamples.md)

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasNestedAreaChart> CreateNestedAreaChartElement( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasNestedAreaChart(const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

| `onSelectionClear` | `std::function<void()> onSelectionClear` | _Selection clear_ |

## Option types in this header

### enum `NestedAreaShapeMode`

/ Shape mode for nested area visualization

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Rectangle` | Nested squares |
| `Circle` | Nested circles (bubble style) |
| `RoundedRect` | Rounded corner squares |

### enum `NestedAreaAlignmentMode`

/ Alignment mode for shape positioning

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `BottomLeft` | Shapes align to bottom-left corner (default) |
| `BottomRight` | Shapes align to bottom-right corner |
| `TopLeft` | Shapes align to top-left corner |
| `TopRight` | Shapes align to top-right corner |
| `Center` | Shapes align to center (concentric) |
| `BottomCenter` | Shapes align to bottom-center |
| `TopCenter` | Shapes align to top-center |

### enum `NestedAreaLabelPosition`

/ Label position for value display

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Inside` | Label inside the shape |
| `Outside` | Label outside the shape |
| `Tooltip` | Label shown on hover only |
| `NoLabels` | No labels |

### enum `NestedAreaColorTheme`

/ Predefined color themes for the chart

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Default` | Blue sequential gradient |
| `Categorical` | Distinct colors for comparison |
| `Sequential` | Light-to-dark single hue |
| `Warm` | Orange/red gradient |
| `Cool` | Blue/teal gradient |
| `Earth` | Brown/green natural tones |
| `Pastel` | Soft muted colors |
| `Vibrant` | High saturation colors |
| `Monochrome` | Grayscale |
| `Ocean` | Blue-cyan theme |
| `Sunset` | Orange-pink-purple theme |
| `Forest` | Green theme |
| `Corporate` | Professional blue-gray |
| `Colorblind` | Accessible color palette |
| `Custom` | User-defined colors |

### struct `NestedAreaDataPoint`

/ Single data point for nested area chart

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `label` | `std::string label` | Display label |
| `value` | `double value = 0.0` | Value (area will be proportional to this) |
| `color` | `Color color = Colors::Transparent` | Explicit color override (Transparent = use theme) |
| `tooltip` | `std::string tooltip` | Custom tooltip text (optional) |
| `category` | `std::string category` | Metadata for additional info display Category grouping |
| `unit` | `std::string unit` | Unit of measurement (e.g., "km²", "$", "people") |

### struct `ShapeCache`

Cached per-shape layout (local coordinates). Label positions are not cached: they are solved at render time by PlaceShapeLabels(), which needs the render context for text measurement.

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `shapeBounds` | `std::vector<Rect2Df> shapeBounds` | Calculated bounds for each shape |
| `shapeRadii` | `std::vector<float> shapeRadii` | Radius for circles / half side for rects |
| `isValid` | `bool isValid = false` |  |
